About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Bybit EU is looking for the Head for Commercial / Business Development to lead our European commercial strategy, market expansion and revenue growth across regulated digital asset and financial services.
Reporting directly to the EU Group CEO, you will lead the European commercial organisation, including Country Managers and their respective in-country Business Development, KOL, VIP Relationship Management and Community teams. You will work closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Compliance and global Commercial teams to drive growth across European markets.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Strategy & Growth

  • Define and execute the European commercial strategy aligned with business objectives, market opportunities and regulatory requirements.
  • Own commercial targets, revenue growth, trading volumes, customer acquisition and market expansion.
  • Identify strategic growth opportunities across retail, active trader, VIP and institutional customer segments.
  • Drive commercial performance through market-specific strategies, resource allocation and measurable KPIs.

Country Management & Market Expansion

  • Lead the European Country Management function, ensuring effective execution of commercial strategies across priority markets.
  • Define country-specific business plans, growth targets and market development priorities.
  • Oversee in-country commercial activities, including business development, partnerships, KOL engagement, VIP relationships and community management.
  • Monitor country performance, competitive positioning and market opportunities to optimise commercial results.

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Drive business development initiatives to expand Bybit EU's customer base, trading activity and market presence.
  • Develop strategic commercial partnerships with relevant fintech, crypto, trading and financial services ecosystems.
  • Identify new distribution opportunities, customer segments and revenue streams.
  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to develop market-relevant propositions and commercial campaigns.

KOL, Affiliate & Community Development

  • Lead European KOL, affiliate and community engagement strategies in collaboration with Marketing.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key influencers, trading communities and ecosystem partners.
  • Drive customer acquisition, engagement and trading activity through effective partner and community programmes.
  • Establish commercial performance targets, partnership frameworks and ROI measurement.

VIP & Key Account Management

  • Lead VIP Relationship Management across European markets, focusing on high-value traders and strategic customers.
  • Develop customer acquisition, retention and relationship strategies for VIP, professional and institutional segments.
  • Drive trading activity, customer loyalty and revenue growth through personalised relationship management.
  • Partner with Product, Trading and Customer Services to deliver competitive propositions and exceptional client experiences.

Commercial Performance & Governance

  • Own commercial budgets, sales forecasts, revenue reporting and performance management across European markets.
  • Establish KPIs covering customer acquisition, activation, trading volumes, retention, revenue and commercial efficiency.
  • Ensure commercial activities, partnerships and customer engagement comply with applicable European regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Compliance, Risk and Legal to maintain appropriate governance over commercial activities and customer relationships.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Build and lead a high-performing European commercial organisation, including Country Managers, Business Development, KOL, VIP Relationship Management and Community teams.
  • Set clear objectives, performance targets and accountability across country and commercial functions.
  • Act as a key member of the European executive leadership team, contributing to business strategy and sustainable growth.
  • Collaborate with global and local stakeholders to align commercial initiatives with European market needs and regulatory requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 15+ years of relevant experience in commercial leadership, business development, sales or market expansion, including significant executive experience in crypto, fintech, trading, brokerage or financial services.
  • Proven experience leading multi-country commercial organisations and delivering sustainable revenue growth across European markets.
  • Strong understanding of crypto trading, digital assets, derivatives and financial services customer segments.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Country Managers, business development teams and international commercial operations.
  • Strong experience developing KOL, affiliate, community and strategic partnership networks within the crypto or trading ecosystem.
  • Proven track record in VIP relationship management, key account development and high-value customer acquisition and retention.
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset with experience managing revenue, trading volumes, customer acquisition, retention and profitability metrics.
  • Experience developing market entry strategies, commercial partnerships and country-specific growth plans.
  • Strong understanding of European markets, regulatory requirements and customer engagement within regulated financial services environments.
  • Proven ability to build high-performing international teams and manage complex stakeholder relationships.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, negotiation, leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English; additional European languages are an advantage
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Management or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

Achieve exceptional results in a high-accountability environment

  • Maintain strong operational rigor in Salesforce: track activity, manage pipeline, and forecast accurately.
  • Measure performance frequently and improve continuously.
  • Consistently exceed quota within a culture where high standards are the norm.

The Key Accounts Customer Success team is responsible for the growth, optimization, stakeholder engagement, and cross‑functional program delivery of Stripe’s most important users. Key Accounts often have complex multi-layered relationships, and are among our most important co-innovation partners. The team partners closely with Sales, Paid Support, Solutions Architecture, Product, and Payments Performance to drive critical outcomes for the users.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for a leader who will manage teams of CSMs focused on a portfolio of our largest Key Accounts at Stripe, driving strategic account planning, product distribution, executive engagement, and payments optimization to maximize retention, expansion, and customer lifetime value.   • Lead and grow a team of senior CSMs focused on Key Accounts: hire, coach, set goals, run calibration and performance reviews, and develop playbooks and operating rhythms for a high-performing strategic CSM organization.

  • Set clear goals focused on product distribution and share of wallet gains that tie directly to business impact. Measure and report on performance metrics at an executive level.
  • Build and scale programmatic account management processes: implement repeatable adoption, churn-risk, optimization, and renewal playbooks that balance scalability with bespoke engagement for strategic accounts.
  • Coordinate cross‑functional delivery and escalation management in support of annual growth initiatives.
  • Own account health, volume forecasting, and growth goals; align Stripe and customer leadership on success metrics.
  • Scale learnings from Key Accounts to other GTM and product teams across Stripe.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 15+ years in customer-facing roles with at least 8+ years leading Strategic Customer Success, Account Management, or related teams.
  • Experience in payments, or fintech; familiarity with Stripe products is a plus.
  • Proven experience managing a small portfolio of strategic large customers
  • Independent, energetic leader with a proven track record of driving organizational change across cross-functional stakeholders and whole-team environments to deliver strong outcomes.
  • Strong programmatic and strategic skills: account planning, project management, stakeholder mapping, and executive engagement.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with CRM/CSM tooling and data platforms (Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker or other BI tools).
  • Prior experience in a high‑growth, matrixed organization.

We are seeking a Market Surveillance Analyst to join our Compliance team. This role is focused on the day-to-day review and investigation of potential market abuse activity. You will use surveillance tools, trading data, and market research to assess alerts and produce timely, well-reasoned investigations supported by clear quantitative and qualitative evidence. The role requires understanding of markets, exchange products, and order-book dynamics, alongside sound judgment. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance, and local Compliance teams to support a robust and continuously improving surveillance framework.   • Investigate potential market abuse activity, including wash trading, circular trading, price ramping, insider trading, spoofing, layering, and other related activities.
  • Review and analyze surveillance alerts using industry-leading tools and platforms.
  • Produce thorough, high-quality investigations supported by clear evidence and well-documented conclusions.
  • Use data, research, and analytical skills to conduct both quantitative and qualitative assessments.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Central Compliance, and local Compliance teams to strengthen and continuously improve the Surveillance function.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and audit-ready documentation for alerts and investigations.
  • Support priority requests and special projects in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
 

What We Look For In You

  • BA/BS in a related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2-3 years of experience in market surveillance, trade surveillance, or closely related field.
  • Familiarity with end-to-end market surveillance workflows.
  • Strong understanding of the digital-asset industry and products offered by digital-asset exchanges.
  • Knowledge of market structure and order-book dynamics.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Strong integrity, sound professional judgment, and the ability to recognize when an issue requires escalation.
  • A self-motivated, proactive approach, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced global environment.
 

Nice to Haves

  • Familiarity with commonly used trade surveillance & reporting tools.
  • Professional AML/ATF compliance training or accreditation (e.g. ICA or CAMS).
  • Practical knowledge of CeFi trading products, including spot, derivatives, margin or leveraged products, institutional services, and OTC flows.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

Ramp is hiring a Lead Recruiter to own Director-level and above hiring across our G&A and business functions. You will lead some of the company’s most critical leadership searches, partnering directly with senior stakeholders to identify and hire leaders who will shape Ramp’s next stage of growth.

You will own searches from initial scoping through close, partnering directly with executives and senior leaders across the business. You will be expected to develop real fluency in each area you support, translate ambiguous business needs into clear hiring strategies, and bring an independent point of view on talent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally strong at research, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating sensitive and confidential searches, and creating structure without slowing the business down. You should be a self-starter who thrives in ambiguity, builds pipelines from scratch, and takes ownership of moving searches forward even when the role, target profile, or process is still taking shape.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Director-level and above roles across G&A and business functions, from intake and market mapping through offer and close.

  • Develop real fluency in the functions you support and quickly build context when taking on a new area, so you can identify the signals that distinguish exceptional leaders beyond title, company, and tenure.

  • Build proactive pipelines through market research, targeted sourcing, referrals, and thoughtful engagement with passive candidates. Independently build momentum on confidential searches where broad outreach or an existing pipeline may not be available.

  • Develop assessment approaches that surface a candidate’s leadership effectiveness, functional expertise, and ability to operate at Ramp’s pace and scale.

  • Move fluidly across functions, evolving role definitions, and competing priorities while maintaining a consistently high bar for talent, execution, and candidate experience.

  • Exercise discretion throughout sensitive searches, managing candidate information and stakeholder communication with sound judgment.

 

What You Need

  • 6+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience.

  • A track record of independently leading complex senior-level searches from initial scoping through accepted offer.

  • Ability to advise senior leaders, challenge requirements, and influence hiring decisions through clear communication, market insight, and data.

  • Demonstrated ability to build fluency in unfamiliar functions, context-switch across very different searches, and maintain strong judgment as priorities and scope change.

  • A high level of ownership and comfort with ambiguity. You can turn an open-ended business need into an actionable search, build a pipeline from scratch, and drive progress without waiting for direction.

  • Strong closing skills, including experience navigating competing offers, senior candidates, and sensitive searches.

     

Nice-to-Have

  • Prior experience in executive search or a dedicated leadership recruiting role, particularly across G&A or business functions.

  • Experience partnering directly with CEOs or other C-suite leaders on critical hires.
